purpose: Define a pure offline decision contract for incremental Jornal Oficial discovery without enabling live recurrence, schedule, collection, persistence or publication.

decisions.NO_CHANGE_IDEMPOTENT: Discovery is complete and exactly matches the completed checkpoint; proposed work queue is empty.
decisions.NEW_ITEMS_APPEND_ONLY: Discovery is a strict append-only superset; only new editions above the checkpoint maximum are proposed for a future separately authorized execution.
decisions.STOP_DISCOVERY_NOT_COMPLETE: Discovery status is partial, unknown or otherwise not PASS_DISCOVERY.
decisions.STOP_DUPLICATE_EDITION: The same edition appears more than once in either checkpoint or discovery.
decisions.STOP_KNOWN_ITEM_MISSING: A previously completed edition disappeared from the discovery result.
decisions.STOP_KNOWN_ITEM_DRIFT: A previously completed edition changed immutable identity metadata.
decisions.STOP_NON_MONOTONIC_NEW_ITEM: A newly observed edition is not strictly above the completed checkpoint maximum.
decisions.STOP_NEW_ITEM_BOUND_EXCEEDED: The proposed append-only delta exceeds the configured per-cycle bound.
decisions.STOP_BAD_ITEM_CONTRACT: An item violates the canonical edition/source_id/logical_key contract.
